profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the aviation and aerospace industry. Skilled in Matlab, Simulink, Python, Public Speaking, and Software Development. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science (M.S.) focused in Electrical Engineering from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: SAP HR Applications Center of Excellence

positions.title: Senior Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Orion Program
-Wrote interface control document for co-manifested payload to Orion interfaces for Artemis IV+
-Managed system capabilities and integration campaigns for docking functionality by aligning the efforts of test engineers, software engineers, and key stakeholders
-Coordinated telemetry, command, and software changes for the optical communications team
-Implemented process and training improvements for the software systems team
-Developed unit tests in C++ using Google Test and verifies test coverage with Parasoft, LCOV, and GCOV in a Linux environment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Flight Controls and Autonomous Systems Department
-Improved electronic flight control software in Simulink for hydraulic status and system control logic
-Reviewed and updates requirements and design documentation in DOORS for new software changes
-Analyzed and approved system and software level test plans and data for new design changes

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Flight Controls and Autonomous Systems Department
-Improved electronic flight control software in Simulink for hydraulic status and system control logic
-Reviewed and updated requirements and design documentation in DOORS for new software changes
-Analyzed and approved system and software level test plans and data for new design changes

positions.title: Associate Flight Controls Engineer
positions.description:
Flight Controls and Autonomous Systems Department
-Created and reviewed new design changes for electronic flight control software and documentation
-Wrote procedures to verify requirements via system and software level testing and C code inspection
-Facilitated peer reviews and change configuration board meetings

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Code Quest Academy (Stretch Assignment)
-Developed an interactive, multi-user platform to increase STEM outreach engagement between Lockheed Martin employee volunteers, high school students, and educators
-Leveraged AWS services (Lambda, Cognito, EC2, S3, Athena) to create a scalable, cost-effective, secure web application
-Wrote use case documentation to establish requirements and streamline design efforts of the five-person web development team
-Used Gatsby and Material UI frameworks to implement styling and layout templates
-Communicated with scrum master, communications team, and legal team about branding and privacy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rotary and Mission Systems Artificial Intelligence Sandbox Environment (Stretch Assignment)
-Documented the architecture of a sandbox environment consisting of cloud and on-premises assets to make AI prototyping more accessible across the Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS) line of business

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Wrote test procedures involving WinCC OA and Spatial Analyzer software and XML files
-Resolved issues that arose during production integration tests for metrology software system of spherically mounted reflectors, laser trackers, and software in WinCC OA and Spatial Analyzer

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-Modified C# code in Visual Studio to enhance functionality of radar modeling and simulation software
-Improved software user manual by creating and altering instructions and flowcharts in Visio Standard

positions.title: Resident Counselor
positions.description:
-Supervised high school residents in residence and dining halls and during outings
-Planned and facilitated group icebreakers and programming

positions.title: Electronics Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Guided high school students in basic circuit building and analysis
-Helped students complete and debug provided code written in C

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
-Updated, inventoried, and transferred hard drive images onto laptops to be used for robotics camps
-Sorted, inventoried, and built projects with robotics kits to prepare educational activities for students

company.name: Center for Initiatives in Pre-College Education

certifications.name: NVIDIA DLI Certificate – Fundamentals of Deep Learning for Computer Vision
certifications.title: NVIDIA DLI Certificate – Fundamentals of Deep Learning for Computer Vision

volunteerExperiences.description: Facilitates 4-6 Python or Java mentoring sessions per year to improve the coding skills of high school students for Lockheed Martin’s Code Quest competition
Improved website created with Gatsby framework to spread awareness of a text messaging service that empowers women to safeguard themselves and leave unsafe situations

projects.title: Open Source ERP Hackathon 2019 at General Assembly NYC
projects.description:
-Worked in a team of four to create an ERP extension for hotel management using Odoo (Open Source ERP built with Python, XML, PostgreSQL) and ShipEngine’s API
-Spearheaded the integration of the ShipEngine API to generate shipping rates for laundry orders
-Awarded the prized for Best ERP Extension

organizations.name: Girls Who Code
organizations.description: Guided ten 6th-12th grade girls through the creation of a website during weekly meetings by teaching them about women in computer science, HTML, and user research. Taught three students to write Python programs for Lockheed Martin’s Code Quest competition

organizations.name: Women's Impact Network at Sikorsky
organizations.position: Be Bold Committee Member · Jul 2018 - Feb 2019
organizations.description: Worked in a group of ten women to recruit executive panelists, create panel questions, and coordinate logistics of a panel to discuss the company’s diversity and inclusion efforts, which was attended by over 150 people
